messages:
sarah-support: Escalating a P1 from Acme — production function/tool calls failing after last deploy. Customers see repeated schema validation errors (400) when invoking the `update_order_status` tool. Including logs and repro.

acme-integration: Confirmed. Started ~2026-03-16T21:12:10Z. ~15% of requests now failing with `SchemaValidationError: expected object, got string` in prod region us-west-2. Works fine in staging.

mike-eng-runtime: Thanks — can you paste the failing request body and the tool schema you're using?

acme-integration: Here's an anonymized example: 
```
POST /v1/invoke
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-chat-2.1",
  "input": "Update order #12345 to {\"status\": \"shipped\"}",
  "tool_call": {"name": "update_order_status", "args": "{\"order_id\":12345,\"status\":\"shipped\"}"}
}
```
Note: args is a JSON string (double-encoded) because the client SDK builds it that way. Logs: `tool-router: selected update_order_status@v2` then `schema-validator: expected object, got string`.

jia-eng-ml: Looks like the router selected the right tool but the args are double-encoded (string instead of object). Our validator enforces args JSON object. Did the client previously send object?

acme-integration: They say this started after yesterday's runtime deploy. They didn't change client code. Possibly router or tokenization change altered how tool args are passed through.

mike-eng-runtime: Copying infra logs: `rpc: toolcall_execute payload_size=312 content_type=application/json args_type=string` then `validator: reject`. Attaching snippet: 
```
2026-03-16T21:12:11.113Z runtime:router: selecting tool update_order_status@v2
2026-03-16T21:12:11.114Z runtime:executor: received tool_call args (string)
2026-03-16T21:12:11.115Z runtime:validator: SchemaValidationError: args must be object
```

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-315 (severity P1) — paging oncall.

paul-support: Affected customers so far: AcmeCorp, ShopRight, and two other mid-market customers. All report same error pattern. Rate of failures 10-20% across orders endpoints.

sarah-support: Repro steps I used: hit production with sample payloads from their SDK (node 0.11.x). On the failing runs the SDK logs show `tool_call.args` serialized as a string. On successful runs args are an object. No client changes.

mike-eng-runtime: Hypothesis: a change in the JSON serialization path in the runtime's request forwarder turned off `preserve_object_args` flag. I rolled a quick debug build to staging and re-ran their SDK — reproduced the stringified args.

jia-eng-ml: Two mitigation paths: 1) Make validator accept string JSON and attempt parse (backward-compatible); 2) Rollback the runtime change that caused double-stringifying. Option 1 is faster but risks masking other issues; option 2 safer.

karen-product: Customer impact is high. Recommend immediate rollback to last stable deploy in us-west-2 while eng investigates.

mike-eng-runtime: Initiating rollback now. ETA ~12 minutes. Will monitor error rate.

acme-integration: Thanks. Please also confirm whether there's any risk of wrong tool being selected (we saw `selected update_order_status@v2` — correct tool). This appears strictly args-format.

mike-eng-runtime: Confirmed correct tool selection. The router metadata matches v2 tag. Only serialization changed.

paul-support: Update from customers: after 8 minutes errors dropped to baseline. They can confirm reduced failures.

mike-eng-runtime: Rollback completed at 2026-03-16T21:28:03Z. Post-rollback logs show `args_type=object` and no schema rejections.

jia-eng-ml: For a durable fix, I'll open a patch to runtime that tolerates string args by attempting `JSON.parse` if validator sees a string and content looks like JSON. We'll add strict-mode toggle per-tenant. Also add a canary test to CI that checks tool_call arg serialization.

mike-eng-runtime: I'll also add a runtime telemetry counter for `toolcall.args_type` so we can spot regressions sooner.

paul-support: Next steps for support: send customers a short incident note: cause = runtime serialization regression, mitigation = rollback, fix = validator tolerant + tests + telemetry, ETA for patch = EOD tomorrow.

sarah-support: Drafting customer message now. Acme asks if we can whitelist their org to be tolerant earlier — recommend we coordinate with eng to enable tenant-level fallback.

jia-eng-ml: We can enable tenant toggle for Acme within the patch window. Please send acme-integration the enable request ID once live.

acme-integration: Appreciate the fast rollback and the patch plan. Please share any SDK guidance — should we update anything client-side?

mike-eng-runtime: No client changes needed; root cause is server-side. We'll also add a short note to SDK release notes: "If you see SchemaValidationError with function args as string, update will be server-side fix."

paul-support: Closing the P1 once the patch merges and tenant toggle is active. Leaving this thread open until patch is live. :white_check_mark:

karen-product: Good follow-up: add an automated synthetic check that sends tool_call with object and string args to catch changes.

sarah-support: Thanks all — will update customers and mark status as monitoring.
